learners.blurb: Practises most days and improves a little each time.

learners.blurb: Struggles for 10 days, then it clicks.

learners.label: Learner E
learners.blurb: Often right, but usually after asking for help.

learners.blurb: Fast and careless: slips on skills already known.

learners.label: Learner G
learners.blurb: Slow, careful, rarely wrong, sometimes skips rather than risk it.

learners.label: Learner H
learners.blurb: Quick start, then no growth after day 7.

learners.label: Learner I
learners.blurb: Practises only on Saturdays and Sundays.

learners.label: Learner J
learners.blurb: Strong at multiplication, weak at spelling throughout.

learners.label: Learner K
learners.blurb: A week away in the middle, then steady work again.

learners.label: Learner L
learners.blurb: Starts from nothing and practises every day.
